spot.html_text: On the one hand, if students have academic freedom, then their freedom of extramural speech ought to be respected. This has intuitive appeal: a student’s op-ed in the student newspaper or their comments on political question on social media is irrelevant to the evaluation of their work as scholars. The instructor assigning a grade or the advisor deciding whether to pass a thesis must not penalize students for such things.
